note: Modern campground wrapped around the east and south shores of 93-acre Crystal Lake, a clear, no-motors lake whose whole shoreline is a designated sand beach (no pets on the shore). A small-craft boat landing is in the campground, and the Heart of Vilas County paved bike trail and Muskellunge Lake Campground are next door. --Claude
summary: NHAL modern-campground page and DNR brochure/map read; GoingToCamp unread (refuses). 100 sites (93 drive-in, 7 walk-to tent), no electric, flush toilets + showers, dump, vault toilets and hand pumps, all reservable, April 1-Dec 1 confirmed. Lakefront -> lakeview proposed (continuous canopy behind a designated public beach). Pin ~1.1 km off at the entrance; re-pin proposed. Stored website dead.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront -> lakeview proposed (the value carries no --AWH). The brochure map puts the lake-side rows on the EAST shore (464-482, 443-449) and the SOUTH shore (401-437, 424-429), not the west/south as the old note said. On Esri imagery (120 m and 300 m half-width at 46.0020,-89.6080 and 46.0010,-89.6100) the whole campground road and every site is under continuous pine/hardwood canopy; the only open ground is a 10-15 m sand strip at the waterline, and the DNR says 'The entire Crystal Lake shoreline is a designated beach' (public day use, no pets). No pad is visible on open ground within about 50 m of the water, so lakefront is not earned; the lake-side rows support lakeview. Site photos are on GoingToCamp (refuses), so I could not check pads under the trees.

PIN: 46.0018,-89.6239 -> 46.0008,-89.6098. The stored point (near the DNR GPS point N46 00.129 W89 37.355) is the campground entrance and visitor station on County N, about 1.1 km WEST of the sites; the lake itself is east of it. The new point is the southeast bend of the lake where the east-shore and south-shore rows meet (imagery estimate; the road is under canopy; the shower building clearing is at about 45.9996,-89.6078).
